subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Gallant
solution:
The correct answer is **Cowardly.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Antonym **refers to words which are opposite in meaning.
 
• The word "**gallant"** means **brave or courageous**.
 
• The correct antonym will be **"Cowardly**" as it means **lack of courage or bravery.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The word**"courageous"** means** "brave"**

 
• The word **"heroic"** means **"courageous"**.
 
• The word "valiant" means "**heroic**

 
• Therefore, all three words have **similar meaning** that is similar to that of "gallant".
